values.note: $20 a night May 15-Oct 15 (reservation season), $10 in the first-come shoulder seasons. A Sleeping Bear Dunes entrance pass is also required for every vehicle in the campground, separate from the camping fee (America the Beautiful passes honored; the Michigan Recreation Passport is not valid). No-show: first night plus $20.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/259242/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-15 PeakTentorRV 20; First-come, First-served Season 2026-04-27 to 05-14 and 2026-10-16 to 11-22 WalkInTentorRV 10) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/259242 ('All visitors must have an entrance pass (separate from camping fees)', 'The Michigan Recreation Passport is not valid for entry at Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore') + https://www.nps.gov/slbe/planyourvisit/dhdaycamp.htm ('A park pass is required for all vehicles using the campground, including those who are visiting campers'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.nps.gov/slbe/planyourvisit/dhdaycamp.htm ('No showers, flush toilets, or RV hook ups are available at D.H. Day Campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 81 wooded sites. In the rec.gov catalog 56 are 'RV nonelectric' (plus walk-to and tent-only sites); RV/trailer lengths are mostly 20 ft (38 sites) or 25 ft (20), with only a few to 27-35 ft and one pull-through, so a 23-ft rig needs a 25-ft-plus site. Generators only in loop 1 (sites 1-31), 9 am-6 pm. Two vehicles per site, only one an RV or trailer.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/259242 ('With 81 beautifully wooded campsites') + RIDB catalog 259242 (Max Vehicle Length 20 x38, 25 x20, 30 x3, 35 x2, 27 x1; Driveway Entry back-in 63, pull-through 1) + https://www.nps.gov/slbe/planyourvisit/dhdaycamp.htm ('Generator use is allowed only in campsites 1-31'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Water spigots through each loop; potable water and dump station at the entrance. Free hot showers at Platte River Campground, 17 miles south on M-22.

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/slbe/planyourvisit/dhdaycamp.htm ('Potable water and a sanitation (dump) station is available at the entrance. Water spigots are also located throughout the campground', 'No showers, flush toilets, or RV hook ups') + rec.gov ('shared water spigots, and vault toilets', 'Free hot showers are available at Platte River Campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Open (weather permitting) April 27 through the fourth Sunday in November; reservations May 15-October 15, first-come before and after.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/259242 (Overview: 'open (weather permitting) from April 27 through the 4th Sunday in November. Reservations are required May 15 through October 15'), read 2026-10-22; the calendar-derived close of 10-15 is the end of the reservation season, so it is cleared

values.note: Reservations required May 15-October 15, up to 6 months ahead (recreation.gov or 1-877-444-6777); first-come at $10 from April 27 to May 14 and from October 16 to closing. The 14-day limit applies Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day. Check in at the campground office on arrival. Operated by the NPS itself (not a concession).

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/slbe/planyourvisit/dhdaycamp.htm ('Regular sites may be reserved up to 6 months in advance for May 15 through October 15', 'Camping is limited to 14 TOTAL DAYS per designated campground between Memorial Day Weekend through Labor Day') + rec.gov rates (First-come, First-served Season) and facility record (org NPS, not commercially managed), read 2026-10-22

summary: NPS page + rec.gov: $20 peak / $10 shoulder (confirmed) plus a required park entrance pass per vehicle (in fees.note); no hookups, showers or flush toilets; vault toilets, spigots, dump; 81 sites, mostly 20-25 ft (max 35, one pull-through); open Apr 27 - 4th Sunday in Nov (calendar-derived close 10-15 cleared, opens 04-27 added); reservable May 15-Oct 15 on rec.gov, 6-month window, FCFS in shoulder seasons, 14-day summer limit. NPS-operated. No closure on the park's conditions page. AWH note kept unchanged.
